distance_scope: Exact shortest travel distances around a four-link closed walkway; each link length is1m. These are route distances between sites, not measured straight-line Cartesian distances.
reporting_policy: Assess existence of an exact Euclidean configuration in ANY dimension. For the fallback representation, form the centered classical squared-distance Gram matrix B=-0.5*H*(D elementwise squared)*H, H=I-11^T/n. Among centered symmetric positive-semidefinite matrices choose the nearest to B in Frobenius norm, without an imposed rank cap. Report its positive-eigenvalue rank and the largest absolute change of the six unordered off-diagonal distances reconstructed from that matrix.
numerical_policy: Use1e-9 absolute tolerance to classify eigenvalues or distance equality. Sum the squared entrywise Gram differences over the FULL matrix for squared Frobenius error. Distances are sqrt(Bii+Bjj-2Bij), not square roots of individual Gram entries.

provenance.data_origin: Explicitly constructed numerical instrument/reporting studies for this benchmark; not measurements from a named laboratory or archive.
provenance.method_scope: Conditional finite-dimensional linear measurement models. Scientific conclusions follow from the stated covariance/distance definitions; no distributional or causal interpretation beyond those assumptions.
